name: video
description: `scene.html` is a single self-contained 1920x1080 motion-graphics scene. Every frame is a pure function of time: `window.renderAt(seconds)` draws the frame, with no CSS transitions or timers. It uses the system fonts Segoe UI and Cascadia Mono, so it renders the same offline on Windows. `render.mjs` steps through the timeline at 30 fps with Playwright and pipes the frames into ffmpeg.
